newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug motorcycle output rises 13.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug motorcycle output rises 13.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production rose 13.6 percent in August from a year earlier to 205,135, the second straight month of year-on-year gains, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association said on Wednesday.

Gains were attributed to an increase in inventories at motorcycle makers ahead of the autumn, when domestic demand usually rises, a JAMA official said.
JAMA expects motorcycle exports in August to have fallen about four percent from a year earlier. It will announce its export figures for the month on September 27.
Domestic motorcycle sales in August fell one percent from a year earlier to 90,593, marking the first year-on-year decline in four months.
